```go
package cursorcloud

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi/schema"
)

// ProviderID is the registry id, also used as ProviderInfo.ID.
const ProviderID = "cursorcloud"

// providerName is the product's own name.
const providerName = "Cursor Cloud Agent"

// vmWorkspaceRoot is where the cloud VM checks out the repository; every
// observed tool path and workingDirectory is under it.
const vmWorkspaceRoot = "/workspace"

// segmentKind orders what an agent produced within one run.
type segmentKind int

const (
	segmentThinking segmentKind = iota
	segmentText
	segmentTool
)

// segment is one contiguous piece of agent output: a run of thinking deltas,
// a run of assistant deltas, or one tool call.
type segment struct {
	kind segmentKind
	text strings.Builder
	time string
	call *toolCall
}

// toolCall is the merged state of every tool_call event sharing a callId.
type toolCall struct {
	callID string
	name   string
	status string
	args   map[string]any
	result map[string]any
	time   string
}

// runTranscript is one run's stream reduced to what renders.
type runTranscript struct {
	userText   string
	userTime   string
	segments   []*segment
	startTime  string
	resultTime string
}

// interactionTypesWithoutContent are interaction_update types observed in
// every capture that carry nothing to render: the *-delta types duplicate the
// thinking and assistant events, the rest are step and tool lifecycle markers.
var interactionTypesWithoutContent = []string{
	"token-delta", "text-delta", "thinking-delta", "thinking-completed",
	"step-started", "step-completed", "tool-call-started", "tool-call-completed",
	"tool-requests-listed", "partial-tool-call", "turn-ended",
}

// parseRunEvents folds a run's events, in stream order, into a transcript.
func parseRunEvents(events []sseEvent, source string) runTranscript {
	var t runTranscript
	calls := map[string]*toolCall{}

	for i, ev := range events {
		ts := eventTime(ev.ID)
		if t.startTime == "" && ts != "" {
			t.startTime = ts
		}
		switch ev.Event {
		case "status", "heartbeat", "done":
			// status opens and closes a run (the run object carries it), heartbeat
			// keeps a quiet live stream open, done marks the end of the stream.
		case "interaction_update":
			var update struct {
				Type        string `json:"type"`
				UserMessage struct {
					Text string `json:"text"`
				} `json:"userMessage"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(ev.Data, &update); err != nil {
				slog.Warn("Skipping undecodable stream event", "source", source, "index", i, "event", ev.Event, "error", err)
				continue
			}
			switch {
			case update.Type == "user-message-appended":
				// The run's prompt; the only place the stream records it.
				t.userText = update.UserMessage.Text
				t.userTime = ts
			case slices.Contains(interactionTypesWithoutContent, update.Type):
			default:
				slog.Debug("Unknown interaction_update type", "source", source, "type", update.Type)
			}
		case "thinking", "assistant":
			var delta struct {
				Text string `json:"text"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(ev.Data, &delta); err != nil {
				slog.Warn("Skipping undecodable stream event", "source", source, "index", i, "event", ev.Event, "error", err)
				continue
			}
			kind := segmentText
			if ev.Event == "thinking" {
				kind = segmentThinking
			}
			t.appendDelta(kind, delta.Text, ts)
		case "tool_call":
			t.mergeToolCall(calls, ev, ts, source, i)
		case "result":
			// The result text repeats the last assistant text, so only its time is used.
			t.resultTime = ts
		default:
			slog.Debug("Unknown stream event", "source", source, "event", ev.Event)
		}
	}
	return t
}

// appendDelta extends the current segment when it is of the same kind, so
// consecutive deltas become one part, and opens a new segment otherwise.
func (t *runTranscript) appendDelta(kind segmentKind, text, ts string) {
	if n := len(t.segments); n > 0 && t.segments[n-1].kind == kind {
		t.segments[n-1].text.WriteString(text)
		return
	}
	seg := &segment{kind: kind, time: ts}
	seg.text.WriteString(text)
	t.segments = append(t.segments, seg)
}

// mergeToolCall applies one tool_call event. A call is placed where its first
// event appears; later events update it field by field, so the last event
// wins. A result on a "running" event is provisional: the stream attaches a
// placeholder error ("Invalid arguments") while arguments are still streaming
// and replaces it when the call completes, so only results from other
// statuses are kept.
func (t *runTranscript) mergeToolCall(calls map[string]*toolCall, ev sseEvent, ts, source string, index int) {
	var payload struct {
		CallID string          `json:"callId"`
		Name   string          `json:"name"`
		Status string          `json:"status"`
		Args   json.RawMessage `json:"args"`
		Result json.RawMessage `json:"result"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(ev.Data, &payload); err != nil || payload.CallID == "" {
		slog.Warn("Skipping undecodable tool_call event", "source", source, "index", index, "error", err)
		return
	}
	call, seen := calls[payload.CallID]
	if !seen {
		call = &toolCall{callID: payload.CallID, time: ts}
		calls[payload.CallID] = call
		t.segments = append(t.segments, &segment{kind: segmentTool, time: ts, call: call})
	}
	if payload.Name != "" {
		call.name = payload.Name
	}
	if payload.Status != "" {
		call.status = payload.Status
	}
	if len(payload.Args) > 0 {
		var args map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(payload.Args, &args); err == nil {
			call.args = args
		}
	}
	if len(payload.Result) > 0 && payload.Status != "running" {
		var result map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(payload.Result, &result); err == nil {
			call.result = result
		}
	}
}

// buildSessionData converts a mirrored agent into SessionData. It returns nil
// when no run yields a user prompt, which means there is nothing to save yet.
func buildSessionData(snap *agentSnapshot, workspaceRoot string) (*schema.SessionData, string) {
	agent := snap.agent
	data := &schema.SessionData{
		SchemaVersion: schema.CurrentSchemaVersion,
		// The API exposes no agent version, so the honest value is "unknown".
		Provider:      schema.ProviderInfo{ID: ProviderID, Name: providerName, Version: "unknown"},
		SessionID:     agent.ID,
		CreatedAt:     agent.CreatedAt,
		UpdatedAt:     agent.UpdatedAt,
		WorkspaceRoot: workspaceRoot,
		Exchanges:     []schema.Exchange{},
	}

	firstPrompt := ""
	for i, run := range snap.runs {
		exchange := buildExchange(snap, i, run, workspaceRoot)
		if exchange == nil {
			continue
		}
		if firstPrompt == "" {
			firstPrompt = firstUserText(exchange)
		}
		data.Exchanges = append(data.Exchanges, *exchange)
	}
	if firstPrompt == "" {
		return nil, ""
	}
	data.Slug = spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstPrompt)
	return data, firstPrompt
}

// buildExchange builds one run's exchange. The stream is the full-fidelity
// source; the v0 conversation (text only) fills in when the stream is missing,
// or when a finished run's capture is partial and the stream has since expired.
func buildExchange(snap *agentSnapshot, index int, run runSnapshot, workspaceRoot string) *schema.Exchange {
	source := snap.dir + "/runs/" + run.run.ID
	useStream := len(run.events) > 0
	if useStream && run.run.isTerminal() && !eventsAreWhole(run.events) && len(v0TurnMessages(snap.conversation, index)) > 0 {
		useStream = false
	}

	var exchange *schema.Exchange
	if useStream {
		exchange = exchangeFromStream(parseRunEvents(run.events, source), run, workspaceRoot)
	}
	if exchange == nil {
		exchange = exchangeFromConversation(snap.conversation, index, run)
	}
	if exchange == nil {
		slog.Debug("Run has no recorded content yet", "agentId", snap.agent.ID, "runId", run.run.ID)
		return nil
	}
	exchange.Metadata = exchangeMetadata(snap.agent, run.run, exchange.Metadata)
	return exchange
}

// exchangeFromStream turns a transcript into messages: the prompt, then agent
// messages in stream order. Thinking and text share one agent message until a
// tool call interrupts; each tool call is its own message.
func exchangeFromStream(t runTranscript, run runSnapshot, workspaceRoot string) *schema.Exchange {
	if t.userText == "" && len(t.segments) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	runID := run.run.ID
	exchange := &schema.Exchange{ExchangeID: runID, StartTime: t.startTime, EndTime: t.resultTime}

	if t.userText != "" {
		userTime := t.userTime
		if userTime == "" {
			userTime = run.run.CreatedAt
		}
		exchange.Messages = append(exchange.Messages, schema.Message{
			ID:        runID + ":user",
			Timestamp: userTime,
			Role:      schema.RoleUser,
			Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: t.userText}},
		})
	}

	var current *schema.Message
	flush := func() {
		if current != nil && len(current.Content) > 0 {
			exchange.Messages = append(exchange.Messages, *current)
		}
		current = nil
	}
	for _, seg := range t.segments {
		switch seg.kind {
		case segmentThinking, segmentText:
			text := seg.text.String()
			if strings.TrimSpace(text) == "" {
				continue
			}
			if current == nil {
				current = &schema.Message{
					ID:        runID + ":" + strconv.Itoa(len(exchange.Messages)),
					Timestamp: seg.time,
					Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
				}
			}
			partType := schema.ContentTypeText
			if seg.kind == segmentThinking {
				partType = schema.ContentTypeThinking
			}
			current.Content = append(current.Content, schema.ContentPart{Type: partType, Text: text})
		case segmentTool:
			flush()
			exchange.Messages = append(exchange.Messages, toolMessage(seg.call, workspaceRoot))
		}
	}
	flush()
	return exchange
}

// toolMessage converts one merged tool call.
func toolMessage(call *toolCall, workspaceRoot string) schema.Message {
	tool := &schema.ToolInfo{
		Name:   call.name,
		Type:   toolType(call.name),
		UseID:  call.callID,
		Input:  cleanToolInput(call.args),
		Output: call.result,
	}
	if markdown := formatTool(tool); markdown != "" {
		tool.FormattedMarkdown = &markdown
	}
	msg := schema.Message{
		ID:        call.callID,
		Timestamp: call.time,
		Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
		Tool:      tool,
		PathHints: pathHints(call.name, tool.Input, workspaceRoot),
	}
	if call.status != "" {
		msg.Metadata = map[string]any{"status": call.status}
	}
	return msg
}

// pathHints lists the files a call wrote. Paths are recorded under the VM's
// /workspace; rewriting that prefix onto the local project lets the shared
// normalizer make them project-relative like every other provider's hints.
func pathHints(name string, input map[string]any, workspaceRoot string) []string {
	var hints []string
	switch toolType(name) {
	case schema.ToolTypeWrite:
		if path := spi.StringValue(input, "path"); path != "" {
			hints = append(hints, spi.NormalizePath(localPath(path, workspaceRoot), workspaceRoot))
		}
	case schema.ToolTypeShell:
		command := spi.StringValue(input, "command")
		cwd := localPath(spi.StringValue(input, "workingDirectory"), workspaceRoot)
		if cwd == "" {
			cwd = workspaceRoot
		}
		for _, hint := range spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot) {
			if !slices.Contains(hints, hint) {
				hints = append(hints, hint)
			}
		}
	}
	return hints
}

// localPath maps a VM path onto the local project root. The root is joined by
// shape with "/" because recorded paths are POSIX; NormalizePath accepts
// either separator.
func localPath(path, workspaceRoot string) string {
	if workspaceRoot == "" {
		return path
	}
	root := strings.TrimRight(workspaceRoot, `/\`)
	if path == vmWorkspaceRoot {
		return root
	}
	if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(path, vmWorkspaceRoot+"/"); ok {
		return root + "/" + rest
	}
	return path
}

// displayPath shows a VM path relative to the repository.
func displayPath(path string) string {
	if path == vmWorkspaceRoot {
		return "."
	}
	if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(path, vmWorkspaceRoot+"/"); ok {
		return rest
	}
	return path
}

// v0TurnMessages returns the v0 messages belonging to run index turn. Ids are
// "turn-N:user" and "turn-N:step:M:assistant"; the agent's very first user
// message has a bare UUID id and belongs to turn 0.
func v0TurnMessages(conv *v0Conversation, turn int) []v0Message {
	if conv == nil {
		return nil
	}
	var out []v0Message
	for _, msg := range conv.Messages {
		if v0MessageTurn(msg.ID) == turn {
			out = append(out, msg)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// v0MessageTurn parses the turn index from a v0 message id.
func v0MessageTurn(id string) int {
	rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(id, "turn-")
	if !ok {
		return 0
	}
	digits, _, _ := strings.Cut(rest, ":")
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(digits)
	if err != nil {
		return -1
	}
	return n
}

// exchangeFromConversation builds a text-only exchange from the v0
// conversation. v0 records no times, so the run's own times stand in.
func exchangeFromConversation(conv *v0Conversation, index int, run runSnapshot) *schema.Exchange {
	messages := v0TurnMessages(conv, index)
	if len(messages) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	exchange := &schema.Exchange{
		ExchangeID: run.run.ID,
		StartTime:  run.run.CreatedAt,
		EndTime:    run.run.UpdatedAt,
		Metadata:   map[string]any{"source": "v0-conversation"},
	}
	for _, msg := range messages {
		if strings.TrimSpace(msg.Text) == "" {
			continue
		}
		role := schema.RoleAgent
		timestamp := ""
		switch msg.Type {
		case "user_message":
			role = schema.RoleUser
			timestamp = run.run.CreatedAt
		case "assistant_message":
		default:
			slog.Debug("Unknown v0 message type", "type", msg.Type, "id", msg.ID)
		}
		exchange.Messages = append(exchange.Messages, schema.Message{
			ID:        msg.ID,
			Timestamp: timestamp,
			Role:      role,
			Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: msg.Text}},
		})
	}
	if len(exchange.Messages) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return exchange
}

// exchangeMetadata records what a reader wants to click: the agent page, the
// branch and pull request, and how the run ended. Token usage lives in the
// usage endpoint per run, not per message, so it stays in RawData rather than
// being forced into the per-message Usage field.
func exchangeMetadata(agent apiAgent, run apiRun, existing map[string]any) map[string]any {
	meta := existing
	if meta == nil {
		meta = map[string]any{}
	}
	meta["runId"] = run.ID
	if run.Status != "" {
		meta["status"] = run.Status
	}
	if run.DurationMs > 0 {
		meta["durationMs"] = run.DurationMs
	}
	if len(run.Git.Branches) > 0 {
		branch := run.Git.Branches[0]
		if branch.Branch != "" {
			meta["branch"] = branch.Branch
		}
		if branch.PrURL != "" {
			meta["prUrl"] = branch.PrURL
		}
	}
	if agent.URL != "" {
		meta["agentUrl"] = agent.URL
	}
	return meta
}

// firstUserText returns the text of an exchange's first user message.
func firstUserText(exchange *schema.Exchange) string {
	for _, msg := range exchange.Messages {
		if msg.Role != schema.RoleUser {
			continue
		}
		for _, part := range msg.Content {
			if part.Type == schema.ContentTypeText && strings.TrimSpace(part.Text) != "" {
				return part.Text
			}
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// sessionName prefers the agent's own name (Cursor sets one, derived from the
// prompt when the launcher gave none) over the shared generator.
func sessionName(agent apiAgent, firstPrompt string) string {
	if name := strings.TrimSpace(agent.Name); name != "" {
		return name
	}
	return spi.GenerateReadableName(firstPrompt)
}

// rawSession is the RawData envelope: the native objects of one mirror read.
type rawSession struct {
	Agent        json.RawMessage `json:"agent"`
	Runs         []rawRun        `json:"runs"`
	Conversation json.RawMessage `json:"conversation,omitempty"`
	Usage        json.RawMessage `json:"usage,omitempty"`
}

type rawRun struct {
	Run    json.RawMessage `json:"run"`
	Events []sseEvent      `json:"events"`
}

// buildRawData serializes the snapshot the session was built from, so RawData
// never describes more than the converted session saw.
func buildRawData(snap *agentSnapshot) (string, error) {
	raw := rawSession{Agent: snap.agentRaw, Conversation: snap.conversationRaw, Usage: snap.usageRaw, Runs: []rawRun{}}
	for _, run := range snap.runs {
		events := run.events
		if events == nil {
			events = []sseEvent{}
		}
		raw.Runs = append(raw.Runs, rawRun{Run: run.runRaw, Events: events})
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("marshal raw data: %w", err)
	}
	return string(data), nil
}
```

```go
package cursorcloud

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
)

// streamRetention is how long the API replays a finished run's stream, as
// advertised by x-cursor-stream-retention-seconds: 86400 on every capture.
const streamRetention = 24 * time.Hour

// mirrorGitignore keeps the project-local mirror out of version control. The
// mirror holds raw API transcripts, which are never redacted (redaction
// applies to markdown and cloud sync), and .specstory/ is usually committed.
const mirrorGitignore = "# Raw Cursor Cloud Agent transcripts mirrored by SpecStory; unredacted, so never committed.\n*\n"

// mirror is the local copy of the API that every read path uses as the
// provider's native store.
type mirror struct {
	root string
}

func (m mirror) agentDir(agentID string) string { return filepath.Join(m.root, "agents", agentID) }

func (m mirror) agentFile(agentID string) string {
	return filepath.Join(m.agentDir(agentID), "agent.json")
}

func (m mirror) runsDir(agentID string) string { return filepath.Join(m.agentDir(agentID), "runs") }

func (m mirror) runFile(agentID, runID string) string {
	return filepath.Join(m.runsDir(agentID), runID+".json")
}

func (m mirror) eventsFile(agentID, runID string) string {
	return filepath.Join(m.runsDir(agentID), runID+".events.jsonl")
}

// agentSnapshot is one consistent read of an agent's mirror directory: every
// conversion, RawData and debug export of a session comes from one snapshot.
type agentSnapshot struct {
	dir             string
	agentRaw        json.RawMessage
	agent           apiAgent
	conversationRaw json.RawMessage
	conversation    *v0Conversation
	usageRaw        json.RawMessage
	runs            []runSnapshot
}

type runSnapshot struct {
	runRaw json.RawMessage
	run    apiRun
	events []sseEvent
}

// loadAgentSnapshot reads an agent directory. A directory without agent.json
// is not an agent yet (a refresh writes agent.json last) and yields nil.
func loadAgentSnapshot(dir string) (*agentSnapshot, error) {
	agentRaw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "agent.json"))
	if err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return nil, nil
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	record, err := decodeAgent(agentRaw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", filepath.Join(dir, "agent.json"), err)
	}
	snap := &agentSnapshot{dir: dir, agentRaw: record.raw, agent: record.agent}

	if raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "conversation.json")); err == nil {
		var conv v0Conversation
		if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal(raw, &conv); jsonErr != nil {
			slog.Warn("Ignoring undecodable conversation", "path", filepath.Join(dir, "conversation.json"), "error", jsonErr)
		} else {
			snap.conversationRaw = raw
			snap.conversation = &conv
		}
	}
	if raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "usage.json")); err == nil && json.Valid(raw) {
		snap.usageRaw = raw
	}

	runsDir := filepath.Join(dir, "runs")
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(runsDir)
	if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		name := entry.Name()
		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".json") {
			continue
		}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(runsDir, name))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		record, err := decodeRun(raw)
		if err != nil {
			slog.Warn("Skipping undecodable run", "path", filepath.Join(runsDir, name), "error", err)
			continue
		}
		events, err := readEventsFile(filepath.Join(runsDir, record.run.ID+".events.jsonl"))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		snap.runs = append(snap.runs, runSnapshot{runRaw: record.raw, run: record.run, events: events})
	}
	// One run is one exchange in creation order. The API lists runs newest
	// first; the id breaks ties so the order never depends on directory order.
	sort.SliceStable(snap.runs, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := snap.runs[i].run, snap.runs[j].run
		if a.CreatedAt != b.CreatedAt {
			return a.CreatedAt < b.CreatedAt
		}
		return a.ID < b.ID
	})
	return snap, nil
}

// agentDirs lists the agent directories in the mirror, sorted by id.
func (m mirror) agentDirs() ([]string, error) {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(m.root, "agents"))
	if err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return nil, nil
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	var dirs []string
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() && validAgentID(entry.Name()) {
			dirs = append(dirs, filepath.Join(m.root, "agents", entry.Name()))
		}
	}
	return dirs, nil
}

// readStoredAgent returns the mirrored agent object, or nil when absent.
func (m mirror) readStoredAgent(agentID string) *apiAgent {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(m.agentFile(agentID))
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	record, err := decodeAgent(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	return &record.agent
}

// ensureRoot creates the mirror root and, for a mirror inside the project,
// the .gitignore that keeps raw transcripts out of commits.
func (m mirror) ensureRoot(projectLocal bool) error {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(m.root, 0o755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !projectLocal {
		return nil
	}
	path := filepath.Join(m.root, ".gitignore")
	if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return writeFileAtomic(path, []byte(mirrorGitignore))
}

// writeFileAtomic replaces path with data via a temporary file and a rename, so
// a concurrent reader sees the old file or the new one, never a torn write.
// An unchanged file is left alone, which keeps the directory fingerprint (and
// so reindex) stable across syncs that bring nothing new.
func writeFileAtomic(path string, data []byte) error {
	if existing, err := os.ReadFile(path); err == nil && bytes.Equal(existing, data) {
		return nil
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), "."+filepath.Base(path)+".tmp-*")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tmpName := tmp.Name()
	if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		_ = os.Remove(tmpName)
		return err
	}
	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(tmpName)
		return err
	}
	if err := os.Rename(tmpName, path); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(tmpName)
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

// writeEvents stores a run's events atomically.
func (m mirror) writeEvents(agentID, runID string, events []sseEvent) error {
	data, err := encodeEvents(events)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return writeFileAtomic(m.eventsFile(agentID, runID), data)
}

// refreshOptions tunes a refresh for its caller.
type refreshOptions struct {
	// skipStreams names runs whose events another goroutine is writing (a live
	// attach); the refresh must not replace their files underneath it.
	skipStreams map[string]bool
	now         time.Time
}

// refreshAgent brings one agent's mirror up to date. Runs, conversation and
// usage are re-fetched only when agent.updatedAt differs from what the mirror
// holds. Streams are fetched for finished runs whose capture is missing or
// partial while the API still retains them; a whole capture is never
// re-fetched. Unfinished runs are not streamed here, because reading a live
// stream blocks until the run ends; the watcher attaches to those instead.
// agent.json is written last so an interrupted refresh is retried next time.
func (m mirror) refreshAgent(ctx context.Context, c *apiClient, record agentRecord, opts refreshOptions) error {
	agentID := record.agent.ID
	stored := m.readStoredAgent(agentID)
	changed := stored == nil || stored.UpdatedAt != record.agent.UpdatedAt

	if changed {
		runs, err := c.listRuns(ctx, agentID)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("list runs: %w", err)
		}
		for _, run := range runs {
			if err := writeFileAtomic(m.runFile(agentID, run.run.ID), run.raw); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if conv, err := c.conversation(ctx, agentID); err != nil {
			slog.Warn("Failed to fetch conversation", "agentId", agentID, "error", err)
		} else if err := writeFileAtomic(filepath.Join(m.agentDir(agentID), "conversation.json"), conv); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if usage, err := c.usage(ctx, agentID); err != nil {
			slog.Warn("Failed to fetch usage", "agentId", agentID, "error", err)
		} else if err := writeFileAtomic(filepath.Join(m.agentDir(agentID), "usage.json"), usage); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	if err := m.fetchMissingStreams(ctx, c, agentID, opts); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if changed {
		return writeFileAtomic(m.agentFile(agentID), record.raw)
	}
	return nil
}

// fetchMissingStreams replays the stream of every finished run whose mirrored
// capture is not whole, while the API still retains it.
func (m mirror) fetchMissingStreams(ctx context.Context, c *apiClient, agentID string, opts refreshOptions) error {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(m.runsDir(agentID))
	if err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		name := entry.Name()
		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".json") {
			continue
		}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(m.runsDir(agentID), name))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		record, err := decodeRun(raw)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		run := record.run
		if !run.isTerminal() || opts.skipStreams[run.ID] || !withinRetention(run, opts.now) {
			continue
		}
		events, err := readEventsFile(m.eventsFile(agentID, run.ID))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if eventsAreWhole(events) {
			continue
		}
		replayed, err := replayStream(ctx, c, agentID, run.ID)
		if errors.Is(err, errStreamExpired) {
			// Expired after all (clock skew or an early purge): the partial
			// capture stays and the v0 conversation fills the exchange.
			slog.Debug("Run stream expired; keeping partial capture", "agentId", agentID, "runId", run.ID)
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("replay stream %s: %w", run.ID, err)
		}
		if err := m.writeEvents(agentID, run.ID, replayed); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// withinRetention reports whether a finished run's stream should still be
// replayable. now is wall-clock time; this decides whether to make a network
// call and never reaches rendered output.
func withinRetention(run apiRun, now time.Time) bool {
	ended, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, run.UpdatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		// Without a parseable end time, trying is cheaper than losing the transcript.
		return true
	}
	return now.Sub(ended) < streamRetention
}

// replayStream reads a finished run's stream from the start to its done event.
func replayStream(ctx context.Context, c *apiClient, agentID, runID string) ([]sseEvent, error) {
	body, err := c.openStream(ctx, agentID, runID, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = body.Close() }()
	var events []sseEvent
	err = readSSE(body, agentID+"/"+runID, func(ev sseEvent) bool {
		events = append(events, ev)
		return ev.Event != "done"
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return events, nil
}

// agentDirFingerprint sums sizes and takes the newest mtime across an agent
// directory: one file (agent.json) does not change when a run's events land.
func agentDirFingerprint(dir string) *spi.SessionFingerprint {
	fp := &spi.SessionFingerprint{}
	_ = filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		info, err := d.Info()
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		fp.Size += info.Size()
		if mt := info.ModTime().UnixNano(); mt > fp.Mtime {
			fp.Mtime = mt
		}
		return nil
	})
	return fp
}
```

```go
package cursorcloud

import (
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
)

// apiKeyEnvVar is the environment variable Cursor's own tooling reads the API
// key from; it overrides the config file so a one-off key needs no edit.
const apiKeyEnvVar = "CURSOR_API_KEY"

// Settings handed in by the CLI at startup. Each is set once before any
// provider method runs, so no locking is needed.
var (
	configAPIKey        string
	configMirrorDir     string
	userDataDirOverride string
)

// SetAPIKey sets the key from `cursor_api_key` in specstory.toml. The
// CURSOR_API_KEY environment variable still wins when set.
func SetAPIKey(key string) {
	configAPIKey = strings.TrimSpace(key)
}

// SetMirrorDir sets the mirror location from `cursorcloud_mirror_dir` in
// specstory.toml (tilde-expanded). Empty keeps the project-local default.
func SetMirrorDir(dir string) {
	configMirrorDir = expandHome(strings.TrimSpace(dir))
}

// SetUserDataDirOverride sets the mirror location from
// `--user-data-dir cursorcloud:<path>`, which wins over the config file.
func SetUserDataDirOverride(dir string) {
	userDataDirOverride = expandHome(strings.TrimSpace(dir))
}

// resolveAPIKey returns the key and where it came from ("" when none).
func resolveAPIKey() (key, source string) {
	if env := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(apiKeyEnvVar)); env != "" {
		return env, apiKeyEnvVar
	}
	if configAPIKey != "" {
		return configAPIKey, "cursor_api_key"
	}
	return "", ""
}

// mirrorFor returns the mirror for a project and whether it lives inside the
// project. The override and config locations are shared by every project; the
// default keeps each project's mirror next to its history.
func mirrorFor(projectPath string) (mirror, bool) {
	if userDataDirOverride != "" {
		return mirror{root: userDataDirOverride}, false
	}
	if configMirrorDir != "" {
		return mirror{root: configMirrorDir}, false
	}
	return mirror{root: filepath.Join(projectPath, ".specstory", "cursorcloud")}, true
}

// globalMirror is the mirror enumerated by reindex, which has no project: the
// shared location when one is configured, else the current project's mirror.
func globalMirror() mirror {
	if userDataDirOverride != "" || configMirrorDir != "" {
		m, _ := mirrorFor("")
		return m
	}
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	if err != nil {
		slog.Warn("ListAllAgentChatSessions: cannot resolve working directory", "error", err)
		return mirror{}
	}
	m, _ := mirrorFor(spi.CanonicalizePathOrClean(cwd))
	return m
}

// projectOrigin returns the normalized origin URL of the project's repository,
// or "" when the project has none. Agents are matched to projects by
// repository, because the API records a repository and never a directory.
func projectOrigin(projectPath string) string {
	origin := spi.GitOriginURL(projectPath)
	if origin == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return spi.NormalizeGitRemoteURL(origin)
}

// agentMatchesOrigin reports whether any of the agent's repositories is the
// project's origin.
func agentMatchesOrigin(agent apiAgent, origin string) bool {
	if origin == "" {
		return false
	}
	for _, repo := range agent.Repos {
		if spi.NormalizeGitRemoteURL(repo.URL) == origin {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// workspaceRootFor is the SessionData workspace root: the caller's project,
// else the process working directory as the documented last resort.
func workspaceRootFor(projectPath string) string {
	if projectPath != "" {
		return projectPath
	}
	if cwd, err := os.Getwd(); err == nil {
		return cwd
	}
	return "."
}

// expandHome expands a leading ~ so config and flag values can use it.
func expandHome(path string) string {
	if path != "~" && !strings.HasPrefix(path, "~/") && !strings.HasPrefix(path, `~\`) {
		return path
	}
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return path
	}
	return filepath.Join(home, strings.TrimLeft(path[1:], `/\`))
}
```

```go
package cursorcloud

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/analytics"
	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/log"
	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
)

// Compile-time assertions that Provider satisfies the full spi.Provider
// contract plus the optional by-path reader used by reindex.
var (
	_ spi.Provider          = (*Provider)(nil)
	_ spi.PathSessionReader = (*Provider)(nil)
)

// checkProbe names the endpoint Check calls, reported in analytics where a
// binary provider reports its version flag.
const checkProbe = "GET /v1/me"

// apiKeyPage is where a user creates a key.
const apiKeyPage = "https://cursor.com/dashboard/api"

// Provider implements spi.Provider for Cursor Cloud Agents, whose
// conversations exist only in Cursor's backend. The Cloud Agents API is the
// native store; a local mirror of it is what every read path parses.
type Provider struct{}

// NewProvider creates a Cursor Cloud Agent provider.
func NewProvider() *Provider {
	return &Provider{}
}

// Name returns the product's name.
func (p *Provider) Name() string {
	return providerName
}

// Check verifies a key is configured and accepted by probing GET /v1/me.
// There is no binary; customCommand is the dashboard opener used by run, so a
// custom one is checked for existence.
func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
	attempt := analytics.CheckAttempt{
		Provider:      ProviderID,
		CustomCommand: customCommand != "",
		CommandPath:   customCommand,
		VersionFlag:   checkProbe,
	}
	slog.Info("Check: verifying Cursor Cloud Agent access", "customCommand", customCommand != "")

	fail := func(errorType, detail, message string) spi.CheckResult {
		slog.Info("Check: failed", "errorType", errorType, "error", detail)
		analytics.TrackCheckFailure(attempt, errorType, detail, "")
		return spi.CheckResult{Success: false, ErrorType: errorType, ErrorMessage: message}
	}

	if customCommand != "" {
		opener := spi.SplitCommandLine(customCommand)
		if len(opener) == 0 {
			return fail(spi.CheckErrorNotFound, "empty command", "The custom command is empty.\n")
		}
		resolved, err := spi.LookPathForCheck(opener[0])
		if err != nil {
			errorType := spi.ClassifyCheckError(err)
			return fail(errorType, err.Error(), fmt.Sprintf(
				"Could not find the dashboard opener: %s\n\n"+
					"• cursorcloud_cmd (or -c) is the command run cursorcloud uses to open https://cursor.com/agents.\n"+
					"• Check the path, or remove the setting to use the system URL opener.\n", opener[0]))
		}
		attempt.ResolvedPath = resolved
	}

	key, source := resolveAPIKey()
	if key == "" {
		return fail(spi.CheckErrorNotFound, "no API key configured", missingKeyMessage())
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), jsonTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	me, err := newAPIClient(key).me(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		var ae *apiError
		if errors.As(err, &ae) && (ae.Status == http.StatusUnauthorized || ae.Status == http.StatusForbidden) {
			return fail(spi.CheckErrorPermissionDenied, err.Error(), fmt.Sprintf(
				"Cursor rejected the API key from %s (HTTP %d).\n\n"+
					"• Create a new key at %s and set %s or cursor_api_key under [providers] in specstory.toml.\n",
				source, ae.Status, apiKeyPage, apiKeyEnvVar))
		}
		return fail(spi.CheckErrorUnknown, err.Error(), fmt.Sprintf(
			"Could not reach the Cursor Cloud Agents API (%s).\n\nError: %v\n\n"+
				"• Accounts on Privacy Mode (Legacy) cannot use cloud agents; switch to standard Privacy Mode.\n"+
				"• Check your network connection and try again.\n", checkProbe, err))
	}

	// The API exposes no agent version; "unknown" says so honestly.
	version := "unknown"
	location := defaultAPIBaseURL
	if me.APIKeyName != "" {
		location = fmt.Sprintf("%s (key %q)", defaultAPIBaseURL, me.APIKeyName)
	}
	slog.Info("Check: succeeded", "keySource", source, "location", location)
	analytics.TrackCheckSuccess(attempt, version)
	return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: location}
}

func missingKeyMessage() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("No Cursor API key is configured.\n\n"+
		"• Create a key at %s\n"+
		"• Then set the %s environment variable, or add it to specstory.toml:\n\n"+
		"    [providers]\n    cursor_api_key = \"crsr_...\"\n", apiKeyPage, apiKeyEnvVar)
}

// DetectAgent reports whether this project has cloud agents: a key is
// configured, the project has a git origin, and either the mirror already
// holds an agent for that repository or the first page of the agent list
// names one.
func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
	key, _ := resolveAPIKey()
	origin := projectOrigin(projectPath)
	found := false
	if key != "" && origin != "" {
		m, _ := mirrorFor(projectPath)
		found = len(m.matchingSnapshots(origin)) > 0
		if !found {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), jsonTimeout)
			agents, err := newAPIClient(key).listAgents(ctx, 1)
			cancel()
			if err != nil {
				slog.Warn("DetectAgent: listing cloud agents failed", "error", err)
			}
			for _, record := range agents {
				if agentMatchesOrigin(record.agent, origin) {
					found = true
					break
				}
			}
		}
	}

	if helpOutput && !found {
		log.UserWarn("\nNo Cursor Cloud Agents were found for this project.\n")
		switch {
		case key == "":
			log.UserMessage("%s\n", missingKeyMessage())
		case origin == "":
			log.UserMessage("Cloud agents are matched to a project by its git origin URL, and this directory has no origin remote.\n")
			log.UserMessage("Run SpecStory from a clone of the repository the cloud agents worked on.\n\n")
		default:
			log.UserMessage("Cloud agents are matched to a project by repository URL. None of your agents worked on %s.\n", origin)
			log.UserMessage("Launch one at https://cursor.com/agents for this repository, then sync again.\n\n")
		}
	}
	return found
}

// GetAgentChatSessions refreshes the mirror for this project's agents, then
// builds every matching session from the mirror. Without a key or network it
// still returns what the mirror already holds.
func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
	origin := projectOrigin(projectPath)
	if origin == "" {
		slog.Debug("GetAgentChatSessions: project has no git origin; no cloud agents can match", "projectPath", projectPath)
		return []spi.AgentChatSession{}, nil
	}
	m, projectLocal := mirrorFor(projectPath)
	refreshed := p.refreshProject(context.Background(), m, projectLocal, origin)

	snapshots := m.matchingSnapshots(origin)
	total := max(len(snapshots), refreshed)
	var sessions []spi.AgentChatSession
	for i, snap := range snapshots {
		if session := convertSnapshot(snap, projectPath, debugRaw); session != nil {
			sessions = append(sessions, *session)
		}
		if progress != nil {
			progress(i+1, total)
		}
	}
	// Agents that failed to refresh and were never mirrored still count, so
	// the progress bar reaches its total.
	if progress != nil && total > len(snapshots) {
		progress(total, total)
	}
	return sessions, nil
}

// refreshProject refreshes every agent for origin and returns how many were
// attempted. Failures are logged per agent; the mirror still serves the rest.
func (p *Provider) refreshProject(ctx context.Context, m mirror, projectLocal bool, origin string) int {
	key, _ := resolveAPIKey()
	if key == "" {
		slog.Debug("No Cursor API key; reading the mirror only")
		return 0
	}
	client := newAPIClient(key)
	agents, err := client.listAgents(ctx, 0)
	if err != nil {
		slog.Warn("Failed to list cloud agents; using the mirror only", "error", err)
		return 0
	}
	attempted := 0
	for _, record := range agents {
		if !agentMatchesOrigin(record.agent, origin) {
			continue
		}
		attempted++
		if err := m.ensureRoot(projectLocal); err != nil {
			slog.Error("Failed to create mirror", "path", m.root, "error", err)
			return attempted
		}
		if err := m.refreshAgent(ctx, client, record, refreshOptions{now: time.Now()}); err != nil {
			slog.Error("Failed to refresh cloud agent", "agentId", record.agent.ID, "error", err)
		}
	}
	return attempted
}

// matchingSnapshots loads every mirrored agent whose repository is origin.
func (m mirror) matchingSnapshots(origin string) []*agentSnapshot {
	dirs, err := m.agentDirs()
	if err != nil {
		slog.Warn("Failed to read mirror", "path", m.root, "error", err)
		return nil
	}
	var snaps []*agentSnapshot
	for _, dir := range dirs {
		snap, err := loadAgentSnapshot(dir)
		if err != nil {
			slog.Warn("Skipping unreadable mirrored agent", "path", dir, "error", err)
			continue
		}
		if snap != nil && agentMatchesOrigin(snap.agent, origin) {
			snaps = append(snaps, snap)
		}
	}
	return snaps
}

// GetAgentChatSession refreshes and returns one agent when it belongs to this
// project, else nil. Membership is checked because the agent list is global
// to the key: an id alone could name another repository's agent.
func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath string, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
	if !validAgentID(sessionID) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	origin := projectOrigin(projectPath)
	if origin == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	m, projectLocal := mirrorFor(projectPath)

	if key, _ := resolveAPIKey(); key != "" {
		ctx := context.Background()
		client := newAPIClient(key)
		record, err := client.getAgent(ctx, sessionID)
		switch {
		case isNotFound(err):
			return nil, nil
		case err != nil:
			slog.Warn("GetAgentChatSession: fetch failed; using the mirror", "sessionId", sessionID, "error", err)
		case !agentMatchesOrigin(record.agent, origin):
			return nil, nil
		default:
			if err := m.ensureRoot(projectLocal); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if err := m.refreshAgent(ctx, client, record, refreshOptions{now: time.Now()}); err != nil {
				slog.Error("GetAgentChatSession: refresh failed", "sessionId", sessionID, "error", err)
			}
		}
	}

	snap, err := loadAgentSnapshot(m.agentDir(sessionID))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if snap == nil || !agentMatchesOrigin(snap.agent, origin) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return convertSnapshot(snap, projectPath, debugRaw), nil
}

// GetAgentChatSessionByPath reads the agent whose agent.json is nativePath.
func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath string, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
	snap, err := loadAgentSnapshot(filepath.Dir(nativePath))
	if err != nil || snap == nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return convertSnapshot(snap, originCwd, debugRaw), nil
}

// convertSnapshot builds the session, its RawData and, when asked, the
// native debug export, all from one snapshot.
func convertSnapshot(snap *agentSnapshot, projectPath string, debugRaw bool) *spi.AgentChatSession {
	data, _ := buildSessionData(snap, workspaceRootFor(projectPath))
	if data == nil {
		slog.Debug("Skipping cloud agent with no recorded prompt yet", "agentId", snap.agent.ID)
		return nil
	}
	raw, err := buildRawData(snap)
	if err != nil {
		slog.Error("Failed to build raw data", "sessionId", snap.agent.ID, "error", err)
		return nil
	}
	if debugRaw {
		if err := writeDebugOutput(snap); err != nil {
			slog.Warn("Failed to write debug output", "sessionId", snap.agent.ID, "path", spi.GetDebugDir(snap.agent.ID), "error", err)
		}
	}
	return &spi.AgentChatSession{
		SessionID:   snap.agent.ID,
		CreatedAt:   snap.agent.CreatedAt,
		Slug:        data.Slug,
		SessionData: data,
		RawData:     raw,
	}
}

// ListAgentChatSessions lists this project's mirrored agents without any
// network access.
func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
	origin := projectOrigin(projectPath)
	result := []spi.SessionMetadata{}
	if origin == "" {
		return result, nil
	}
	m, _ := mirrorFor(projectPath)
	for _, snap := range m.matchingSnapshots(origin) {
		data, firstPrompt := buildSessionData(snap, workspaceRootFor(projectPath))
		if data == nil {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
			SessionID: snap.agent.ID,
			CreatedAt: snap.agent.CreatedAt,
			Slug:      data.Slug,
			Name:      sessionName(snap.agent, firstPrompt),
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates the mirror across every project.
// OriginCwd stays empty: the API records a repository, never a directory, so
// reindex files these sessions under the unknown project.
func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
	m := globalMirror()
	refs := []spi.GlobalSessionRef{}
	if m.root == "" {
		return refs, nil
	}
	dirs, err := m.agentDirs()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, dir := range dirs {
		snap, err := loadAgentSnapshot(dir)
		if err != nil {
			slog.Warn("reindex: skipping unreadable mirrored agent", "path", dir, "error", err)
			continue
		}
		if snap == nil {
			continue
		}
		data, firstPrompt := buildSessionData(snap, workspaceRootFor(""))
		if data == nil {
			continue
		}
		refs = append(refs, spi.GlobalSessionRef{
			SessionID:   snap.agent.ID,
			CreatedAt:   snap.agent.CreatedAt,
			Slug:        data.Slug,
			Name:        sessionName(snap.agent, firstPrompt),
			NativePath:  filepath.Join(dir, "agent.json"),
			Fingerprint: agentDirFingerprint(dir),
		})
	}
	return refs, nil
}

// runDebugFileRe matches the per-run debug files this provider writes.
var runDebugFileRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^run-[1-9][0-9]*-run-[0-9A-Fa-f-]+\.json$`)

// ownsDebugFile identifies provider-owned debug files, so a refresh removes
// stale ones (a run file from a longer earlier export) and leaves the
// CLI-owned session-data.json alone.
func ownsDebugFile(name string) bool {
	switch name {
	case "agent.json", "conversation.json", "usage.json":
		return true
	}
	return runDebugFileRe.MatchString(name)
}

// writeDebugOutput exports the snapshot's native objects pretty-printed:
// agent.json, conversation.json, usage.json and run-<n>-<runId>.json holding
// the run object and its events, numbered in run order.
func writeDebugOutput(snap *agentSnapshot) error {
	dir := spi.GetDebugDir(snap.agent.ID)
	if err := spi.PrepareDebugDir(dir, ownsDebugFile); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	write := func(name string, raw []byte) error {
		var pretty bytes.Buffer
		if err := json.Indent(&pretty, raw, "", "  "); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("format debug file %s: %w", name, err)
		}
		path := filepath.Join(dir, name)
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, pretty.Bytes(), 0o644); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("write debug file %s: %w", path, err)
		}
		return nil
	}
	if err := write("agent.json", snap.agentRaw); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(snap.conversationRaw) > 0 {
		if err := write("conversation.json", snap.conversationRaw); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if len(snap.usageRaw) > 0 {
		if err := write("usage.json", snap.usageRaw); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	for i, run := range snap.runs {
		events := run.events
		if events == nil {
			events = []sseEvent{}
		}
		raw, err := json.Marshal(rawRun{Run: run.runRaw, Events: events})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := write(fmt.Sprintf("run-%d-%s.json", i+1, run.run.ID), raw); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// noProjectOriginError explains why watch cannot start in a directory with no
// git origin.
func noProjectOriginError(projectPath string) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("cursor cloud agents are matched by repository, and %s has no git origin remote", strings.TrimSpace(projectPath))
}
```

```text
// Cursor stores a session as a SQLite store.db: a content-addressed Merkle-DAG of
// blobs where each blob's id == sha256(data). Conversation messages are PLAIN JSON
// blobs; small protobuf "index" nodes thread them into the DAG; `meta['0']` carries
// the head pointer (`latestRootBlobId`). Tool calls and thinking are already
// flattened into agent text by FlattenSessionData, so reconstruction emits only
// user/assistant text-message blobs. The structure below (messages + root + a
// field-2 metadata subtree of title/empty/preview nodes, with NO system message)
// was validated against `cursor-agent --resume`. See docs/SESSION-PORTABILITY.md.

// blobID returns the content-addressed id Cursor uses: sha256(data), hex-encoded.
func blobID(data []byte) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

// pbField encodes a protobuf length-delimited field (wire type 2). fieldNum must be < 16.
func pbField(fieldNum int, payload []byte) []byte {
	out := []byte{byte(fieldNum<<3 | 2)}
	var lenBuf [binary.MaxVarintLen64]byte
	n := binary.PutUvarint(lenBuf[:], uint64(len(payload)))
```

```go
package cursorcloud

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"log/slog"
	"maps"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
)

// Watcher tuning. A remote store has no filesystem events, so a poll of the
// agent list is the change signal. Variables so tests can run in milliseconds.
var (
	// pollInterval keeps the poll (one request per page) far inside the
	// 20-requests-per-minute budget, leaving room for refreshes and streams.
	pollInterval = 60 * time.Second
	// emitDebounce coalesces a burst of stream events into one save; the
	// burst's last event is usually the completed text.
	emitDebounce = 2 * time.Second
	// reconnectDelay is the first wait before reattaching a dropped stream.
	reconnectDelay = 5 * time.Second
)

const (
	// maxLiveStreams bounds concurrent stream connections; each holds a
	// connection open for the length of a run.
	maxLiveStreams = 4
	// maxStreamReconnects bounds reattaching one dropped stream.
	maxStreamReconnects = 5
	// maxPollPages bounds the agents scanned per poll. The list is newest
	// first, so 300 agents covers any agent a person is actively running.
	maxPollPages = 3
)

// cloudWatcher polls the agent list and follows running runs live.
type cloudWatcher struct {
	origin       string
	projectPath  string
	mirror       mirror
	projectLocal bool
	client       *apiClient
	debugRaw     bool
	callback     func(*spi.AgentChatSession)

	ctx       context.Context
	cancel    context.CancelFunc
	startedAt time.Time

	mu      sync.Mutex
	seen    map[string]string // agent id -> updatedAt last acted on
	live    map[string]bool   // run ids with an attached stream
	pending map[string]bool   // agent ids queued for emission
	emitCh  chan string

	workers  sync.WaitGroup // poll loop and stream followers
	emitter  sync.WaitGroup // the single delivery worker
	stopOnce sync.Once
}

func newCloudWatcher(projectPath, origin string, client *apiClient, debugRaw bool, callback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) *cloudWatcher {
	m, projectLocal := mirrorFor(projectPath)
	return &cloudWatcher{
		origin:       origin,
		projectPath:  projectPath,
		mirror:       m,
		projectLocal: projectLocal,
		client:       client,
		debugRaw:     debugRaw,
		callback:     callback,
		seen:         map[string]string{},
		live:         map[string]bool{},
		pending:      map[string]bool{},
	}
}

// start begins polling. The context is created per start so a stopped
// watcher can be started again.
func (w *cloudWatcher) start(parent context.Context) {
	w.ctx, w.cancel = context.WithCancel(parent)
	w.startedAt = time.Now()
	w.emitCh = make(chan string, 64)
	w.stopOnce = sync.Once{}
	w.emitter.Go(w.emitLoop)
	w.workers.Go(w.pollLoop)
}

// stop cancels polling and streams, waits for every follower to write its
// final events and queue any update not yet delivered, then drains delivery.
func (w *cloudWatcher) stop() {
	w.stopOnce.Do(func() {
		w.cancel()
		w.workers.Wait()
		close(w.emitCh)
		w.emitter.Wait()
	})
}

// pollLoop runs the baseline poll, then polls every pollInterval.
func (w *cloudWatcher) pollLoop() {
	baseline := true
	for {
		w.poll(baseline)
		baseline = false
		if sleepContext(w.ctx, pollInterval) != nil {
			return
		}
	}
}

// poll lists agents and acts on the ones for this project. The baseline poll
// mirrors whatever is new but emits nothing: existing sessions are not news
// because the watcher started. Afterwards an agent seen for the first time or
// whose updatedAt moved is refreshed and emitted. An agent changing during the
// baseline is caught by the next poll, because the baseline records the
// updatedAt it listed, not what the agent became.
func (w *cloudWatcher) poll(baseline bool) {
	agents, err := w.client.listAgents(w.ctx, maxPollPages)
	if err != nil {
		if w.ctx.Err() == nil {
			slog.Warn("WatchAgent: listing cloud agents failed; retrying next poll", "error", err)
		}
		return
	}
	for _, record := range agents {
		if w.ctx.Err() != nil {
			return
		}
		agent := record.agent
		if !agentMatchesOrigin(agent, w.origin) {
			continue
		}
		w.mu.Lock()
		prev, known := w.seen[agent.ID]
		skip := w.liveSnapshot()
		w.mu.Unlock()
		if known && prev == agent.UpdatedAt {
			continue
		}

		if err := w.mirror.ensureRoot(w.projectLocal); err != nil {
			slog.Error("WatchAgent: cannot create mirror", "path", w.mirror.root, "error", err)
			return
		}
		if err := w.mirror.refreshAgent(w.ctx, w.client, record, refreshOptions{skipStreams: skip, now: time.Now()}); err != nil {
			if w.ctx.Err() == nil {
				slog.Error("WatchAgent: refreshing cloud agent failed", "agentId", agent.ID, "error", err)
			}
			continue
		}
		w.mu.Lock()
		w.seen[agent.ID] = agent.UpdatedAt
		w.mu.Unlock()
		if baseline {
			slog.Debug("WatchAgent: baseline", "agentId", agent.ID, "updatedAt", agent.UpdatedAt)
		} else {
			slog.Info("WatchAgent: cloud agent updated", "agentId", agent.ID, "updatedAt", agent.UpdatedAt)
			w.enqueue(agent.ID)
		}
	}
	w.attachRunning()
}

// liveSnapshot copies the attached-run set; callers hold w.mu.
func (w *cloudWatcher) liveSnapshot() map[string]bool {
	return maps.Clone(w.live)
}

// attachRunning starts a follower for every unfinished run in this project's
// mirror that has none, up to maxLiveStreams.
func (w *cloudWatcher) attachRunning() {
	for _, snap := range w.mirror.matchingSnapshots(w.origin) {
		for _, run := range snap.runs {
			if run.run.isTerminal() {
				continue
			}
			w.mu.Lock()
			attach := !w.live[run.run.ID] && len(w.live) < maxLiveStreams && w.ctx.Err() == nil
			if attach {
				w.live[run.run.ID] = true
			}
			w.mu.Unlock()
			if !attach {
				continue
			}
			agentID, runID := snap.agent.ID, run.run.ID
			slog.Info("WatchAgent: following live run", "agentId", agentID, "runId", runID)
			w.workers.Go(func() {
				w.followRun(agentID, runID)
				w.mu.Lock()
				delete(w.live, runID)
				w.mu.Unlock()
			})
		}
	}
}

// followRun streams a run into its events file until the run ends or the
// watcher stops. Events are flushed and the session queued for delivery after
// each burst (debounced), once more when the run ends, and on stop if an
// update is still undelivered. Only events stamped after the watcher started
// count as activity: attaching replays the run from its start.
func (w *cloudWatcher) followRun(agentID, runID string) {
	events, err := readEventsFile(w.mirror.eventsFile(agentID, runID))
	if err != nil {
		slog.Error("WatchAgent: reading mirrored events failed", "runId", runID, "error", err)
		return
	}
	if eventsAreWhole(events) {
		return
	}
	undelivered := false
	flush := func() {
		if err := w.mirror.writeEvents(agentID, runID, events); err != nil {
			slog.Error("WatchAgent: writing events failed", "runId", runID, "error", err)
		}
		if undelivered {
			w.enqueue(agentID)
			undelivered = false
		}
	}

	done := false
	delay := reconnectDelay
	for attempt := 0; !done && w.ctx.Err() == nil && attempt <= maxStreamReconnects; attempt++ {
		lastID := lastEventID(events)
		body, err := w.client.openStream(w.ctx, agentID, runID, lastID)
		if errors.Is(err, errStreamExpired) {
			slog.Info("WatchAgent: run stream expired", "runId", runID)
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			if w.ctx.Err() == nil {
				slog.Warn("WatchAgent: stream connect failed", "runId", runID, "attempt", attempt+1, "error", err)
				_ = sleepContext(w.ctx, delay)
				delay = min(delay*2, maxBackoff)
			}
			continue
		}

		// A resumed stream may repeat events carrying the resume id: ids are
		// not unique (a thinking event and its interaction_update share one).
		repeats := eventsWithID(events, lastID)
		incoming := make(chan sseEvent)
		var reader sync.WaitGroup
		var readErr error
		reader.Go(func() {
			defer close(incoming)
			readErr = readSSE(body, agentID+"/"+runID, func(ev sseEvent) bool {
				select {
				case incoming <- ev:
					return ev.Event != "done"
				case <-w.ctx.Done():
					return false
				}
			})
		})

		debounce := time.NewTimer(emitDebounce)
		debounce.Stop()
	receive:
		for {
			select {
			case ev, ok := <-incoming:
				if !ok {
					break receive
				}
				if lastID != "" && ev.ID == lastID && repeats[eventKey(ev)] {
					continue
				}
				events = append(events, ev)
				if t, ok := eventInstant(ev.ID); ok && !t.Before(w.startedAt) {
					undelivered = true
				}
				if ev.Event == "done" {
					done = true
				}
				debounce.Reset(emitDebounce)
			case <-debounce.C:
				flush()
			case <-w.ctx.Done():
				break receive
			}
		}
		debounce.Stop()
		_ = body.Close()
		reader.Wait()
		if readErr != nil && w.ctx.Err() == nil && !done {
			slog.Warn("WatchAgent: stream dropped; reconnecting", "runId", runID, "error", readErr)
		}
	}

	if done {
		// The run object now says how the run ended; fetch it so the exchange
		// carries the final status and branch.
		if runs, err := w.client.listRuns(w.ctx, agentID); err == nil {
			for _, run := range runs {
				if err := writeFileAtomic(w.mirror.runFile(agentID, run.run.ID), run.raw); err != nil {
					slog.Error("WatchAgent: writing run failed", "runId", run.run.ID, "error", err)
				}
			}
		} else if w.ctx.Err() == nil {
			slog.Warn("WatchAgent: refreshing finished run failed", "runId", runID, "error", err)
		}
		slog.Info("WatchAgent: live run finished", "agentId", agentID, "runId", runID)
	}
	flush()
}

// lastEventID returns the id of the last event that carries one.
func lastEventID(events []sseEvent) string {
	for i := len(events) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		if events[i].ID != "" {
			return events[i].ID
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// eventsWithID returns the identities of recorded events with the given id.
func eventsWithID(events []sseEvent, id string) map[string]bool {
	set := map[string]bool{}
	if id == "" {
		return set
	}
	for _, ev := range events {
		if ev.ID == id {
			set[eventKey(ev)] = true
		}
	}
	return set
}

func eventKey(ev sseEvent) string {
	data, _ := json.Marshal(ev)
	return string(data)
}

// enqueue queues an agent for delivery, coalescing repeats still waiting.
func (w *cloudWatcher) enqueue(agentID string) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	if w.pending[agentID] {
		w.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	w.pending[agentID] = true
	w.mu.Unlock()
	w.emitCh <- agentID
}

// emitLoop delivers sessions one at a time, in queue order, from the mirror.
func (w *cloudWatcher) emitLoop() {
	for agentID := range w.emitCh {
		w.mu.Lock()
		delete(w.pending, agentID)
		w.mu.Unlock()
		snap, err := loadAgentSnapshot(w.mirror.agentDir(agentID))
		if err != nil || snap == nil {
			slog.Warn("WatchAgent: cannot read mirrored agent", "agentId", agentID, "error", err)
			continue
		}
		session := convertSnapshot(snap, w.projectPath, w.debugRaw)
		if session == nil {
			continue
		}
		spi.DeliverSession("WatchAgent", w.callback, session)
	}
}
```

```go
package cursorcloud

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"os/signal"
	"runtime"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
)

// dashboardURL is where cloud agents are launched and followed.
const dashboardURL = "https://cursor.com/agents"

// ExecAgentAndWatch is `run` for a hosted agent. No local process exists, so
// it opens the cloud agents dashboard (or one agent's page when resuming) with
// the configured opener and then watches until Ctrl-C exactly like WatchAgent.
func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
	slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: starting", "projectPath", projectPath, "customCommand", customCommand, "resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID, "debugRaw", debugRaw)

	target := dashboardURL
	if resumeSessionID != "" {
		if validAgentID(resumeSessionID) {
			target = dashboardURL + "/" + resumeSessionID
		} else {
			slog.Warn("ExecAgentAndWatch: ignoring malformed agent id", "resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID)
		}
	}
	if err := openURL(customCommand, target); err != nil {
		// Watching still works when the browser could not be opened; the
		// user can follow the printed URL.
		slog.Warn("ExecAgentAndWatch: opening the dashboard failed", "url", target, "error", err)
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Could not open %s (%v). Open it in a browser; watching for Cursor Cloud Agent activity — press Ctrl-C to stop.\n", target, err)
	} else {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Opened %s — watching for Cursor Cloud Agent activity, press Ctrl-C to stop.\n", target)
	}

	ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer cancel()
	err := p.WatchAgent(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		err = nil
	}
	slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: exiting", "error", err)
	return err
}

// openURL runs the opener with url appended. The default is the platform's
// URL handler; a custom command (cursorcloud_cmd or -c) replaces it.
func openURL(customCommand, url string) error {
	args := spi.SplitCommandLine(customCommand)
	if len(args) == 0 {
		args = defaultOpener()
	}
	if len(args) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("no URL opener for %s", runtime.GOOS)
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(args[0], append(args[1:], url)...)
	slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: opening dashboard", "command", args[0], "url", url)
	return cmd.Run()
}

// defaultOpener is the platform's own URL handler.
func defaultOpener() []string {
	switch runtime.GOOS {
	case "darwin":
		return []string{"open"}
	case "windows":
		return []string{"rundll32", "url.dll,FileProtocolHandler"}
	default:
		return []string{"xdg-open"}
	}
}

// WatchAgent polls for cloud agent activity on this project's repository and
// delivers each new or updated session until ctx is cancelled.
func (p *Provider) WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
	slog.Info("WatchAgent: starting Cursor Cloud Agent polling", "projectPath", projectPath, "debugRaw", debugRaw)
	key, source := resolveAPIKey()
	if key == "" {
		slog.Info("WatchAgent: no API key configured")
		return errors.New("no Cursor API key: set CURSOR_API_KEY or cursor_api_key under [providers] in specstory.toml")
	}
	origin := projectOrigin(projectPath)
	if origin == "" {
		slog.Info("WatchAgent: project has no git origin", "projectPath", projectPath)
		return noProjectOriginError(projectPath)
	}

	watcher := newCloudWatcher(projectPath, origin, newAPIClient(key), debugRaw, sessionCallback)
	watcher.start(ctx)
	slog.Info("WatchAgent: polling", "origin", origin, "keySource", source, "mirror", watcher.mirror.root, "interval", pollInterval)

	<-ctx.Done()
	slog.Info("WatchAgent: context cancelled, stopping")
	watcher.stop()
	slog.Info("WatchAgent: stopped")
	return ctx.Err()
}
```

```text
// TestProvidersConfigIsFullyWired guards the gap that shipped with the Pi provider:
// ProvidersConfig had no pi_cmd field, so `pi_cmd` in config.toml did nothing. Nothing
// errored — TOML tolerates a key with no struct field, and GetProviderCmd's default arm
// returns "" — so the only symptom was a setting that silently had no effect.
//
// A provider command is only usable when all three are present, so each field is checked
// against the other two: the struct field (here), a line in the config template (so a user
// can discover it), and a GetProviderCmd case (so it takes effect). The provider id is
// derived from the toml key, which also pins the naming convention every provider follows:
// pi_cmd -> "pi", copilotide_insiders_cmd -> "copilotide-insiders".
	})

	t.Run("empty config returns empty provider commands", func(t *testing.T) {
		tempHome := t.TempDir()
		tempProject := t.TempDir()

		testutil.SetHome(t, tempHome)
		t.Chdir(tempProject)

		cfg, err := Load(nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Load() returned error: %v", err)
		}

		for _, id := range []string{
			"antigravity", "claude", "codex",
			"copilotide", "copilotide-insiders", "copilotide-vscodium", "copilotide-vscodium-insiders",
			"cursor", "cursoride", "deepseek", "droid", "gemini", "grok", "muse", "opencode", "pi", "qwen",
		} {
			if got := cfg.GetProviderCmd(id); got != "" {
				t.Errorf("GetProviderCmd(%s) = %q, want empty", id, got)
			}
		}
	})
}
```

```go
package cursorcloud

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// fixture is one captured agent from testdata: the API objects as recorded
// and each run's SSE stream.
type fixture struct {
	agent        agentRecord
	runs         []runRecord
	streams      map[string][]byte
	conversation json.RawMessage
	usage        json.RawMessage
}

// loadFixture reads testdata/<name>. A run's stream is stream-<runId>.sse,
// or stream-live.sse in the single-run captures.
func loadFixture(t *testing.T, name string) fixture {
	t.Helper()
	dir := filepath.Join("testdata", name)
	read := func(file string) []byte {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, file))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("read fixture %s/%s: %v", name, file, err)
		}
		return data
	}
	agent, err := decodeAgent(read("agent.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var runList struct {
		Items []json.RawMessage `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(read("runs.json"), &runList); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fx := fixture{agent: agent, streams: map[string][]byte{}, conversation: read("v0-conversation.json"), usage: read("usage.json")}
	for _, item := range runList.Items {
		run, err := decodeRun(item)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		fx.runs = append(fx.runs, run)
		stream, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "stream-"+run.run.ID+".sse"))
		if os.IsNotExist(err) && len(runList.Items) == 1 {
			stream, err = os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "stream-live.sse"))
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("stream for %s: %v", run.run.ID, err)
		}
		fx.streams[run.run.ID] = stream
	}
	return fx
}

// parseSSEBytes parses a captured stream with the production reader.
func parseSSEBytes(t *testing.T, data []byte) []sseEvent {
	t.Helper()
	var events []sseEvent
	if err := readSSE(strings.NewReader(string(data)), "test", func(ev sseEvent) bool {
		events = append(events, ev)
		return true
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return events
}

// writeFixtureMirror writes a fixture into a mirror as a whole capture.
func writeFixtureMirror(t *testing.T, m mirror, fx fixture) {
	t.Helper()
	id := fx.agent.agent.ID
	for _, run := range fx.runs {
		if err := writeFileAtomic(m.runFile(id, run.run.ID), run.raw); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := m.writeEvents(id, run.run.ID, parseSSEBytes(t, fx.streams[run.run.ID])); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for file, data := range map[string][]byte{"conversation.json": fx.conversation, "usage.json": fx.usage, "agent.json": fx.agent.raw} {
		if err := writeFileAtomic(filepath.Join(m.agentDir(id), file), data); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

// fakeAPI serves captured fixtures as the Cloud Agents API.
type fakeAPI struct {
	t        *testing.T
	server   *httptest.Server
	mu       sync.Mutex
	agents   []json.RawMessage
	runs     map[string][]json.RawMessage
	streams  map[string][]byte
	expired  map[string]bool
	convs    map[string]json.RawMessage
	usages   map[string]json.RawMessage
	pageSize int // 0 = one page

	// streamHandler, when set, serves run streams instead of the stored bytes.
	streamHandler func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, runID string)
	// onRequest is called (without the lock) before each request is served.
	onRequest func(path string)
	meStatus  int
	requests  map[string]int
}

// newFakeAPI starts a server, points the client at it and lifts the rate
// limit so tests run at full speed.
func newFakeAPI(t *testing.T) *fakeAPI {
	t.Helper()
	f := &fakeAPI{
		t: t, runs: map[string][]json.RawMessage{}, streams: map[string][]byte{}, expired: map[string]bool{},
		convs: map[string]json.RawMessage{}, usages: map[string]json.RawMessage{}, requests: map[string]int{},
	}
	f.server = httptest.NewServer(f)
	prevBase, prevLimiter := apiBaseURL, sharedLimiter
	apiBaseURL = f.server.URL
	sharedLimiter = newRateLimiter(0)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		f.server.Close()
		apiBaseURL, sharedLimiter = prevBase, prevLimiter
	})
	return f
}

// addFixture serves a fixture and returns its agent id.
func (f *fakeAPI) addFixture(fx fixture) string {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	id := fx.agent.agent.ID
	f.agents = append(f.agents, fx.agent.raw)
	for _, run := range fx.runs {
		f.runs[id] = append(f.runs[id], run.raw)
		f.streams[run.run.ID] = fx.streams[run.run.ID]
	}
	f.convs[id] = fx.conversation
	f.usages[id] = fx.usage
	return id
}

// setAgent replaces an agent object (matched by id) or adds it.
func (f *fakeAPI) setAgent(raw json.RawMessage) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	record, err := decodeAgent(raw)
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i, existing := range f.agents {
		if r, _ := decodeAgent(existing); r.agent.ID == record.agent.ID {
			f.agents[i] = raw
			return
		}
	}
	f.agents = append(f.agents, raw)
}

func (f *fakeAPI) count(prefix string) int {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	n := 0
	for path, c := range f.requests {
		if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
			n += c
		}
	}
	return n
}

func (f *fakeAPI) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer test-key" {
		writeAPIError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "bad key")
		return
	}
	if f.onRequest != nil {
		f.onRequest(r.URL.Path)
	}
	f.mu.Lock()
	f.requests[r.URL.Path]++
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	f.mu.Unlock()

	switch {
	case r.URL.Path == "/v1/me":
		if f.meStatus != 0 {
			writeAPIError(w, f.meStatus, "unauthorized", "Invalid API key")
			return
		}
		data, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata", "api", "me.json"))
		_, _ = w.Write(data)
	case r.URL.Path == "/v1/agents":
		f.serveAgentList(w, r)
	case len(parts) == 3 && parts[0] == "v1":
		f.serveAgentPart(w, parts[2], "")
	case len(parts) == 4 && parts[0] == "v1" && parts[3] == "runs":
		f.mu.Lock()
		items := f.runs[parts[2]]
		f.mu.Unlock()
		writeJSON(w, map[string]any{"items": items})
	case len(parts) == 4 && parts[0] == "v1" && parts[3] == "usage":
		f.serveAgentPart(w, parts[2], "usage")
	case len(parts) == 4 && parts[0] == "v0" && parts[3] == "conversation":
		f.serveAgentPart(w, parts[2], "conversation")
	case len(parts) == 6 && parts[5] == "stream":
		f.serveStream(w, r, parts[4])
	default:
		writeAPIError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "no route")
	}
}

func (f *fakeAPI) serveAgentList(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	agents := append([]json.RawMessage(nil), f.agents...)
	pageSize := f.pageSize
	f.mu.Unlock()
	start, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("cursor"))
	end := len(agents)
	if pageSize > 0 {
		end = min(start+pageSize, len(agents))
	}
	page := map[string]any{"items": agents[start:end]}
	if end < len(agents) {
		page["nextCursor"] = strconv.Itoa(end)
	}
	writeJSON(w, page)
}

func (f *fakeAPI) serveAgentPart(w http.ResponseWriter, agentID, part string) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	var body json.RawMessage
	switch part {
	case "usage":
		body = f.usages[agentID]
	case "conversation":
		body = f.convs[agentID]
	default:
		for _, raw := range f.agents {
			if r, _ := decodeAgent(raw); r.agent.ID == agentID {
				body = raw
			}
		}
	}
	if body == nil {
		writeAPIError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "Agent not found")
		return
	}
	_, _ = w.Write(body)
}

func (f *fakeAPI) serveStream(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, runID string) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	expired, stream, handler := f.expired[runID], f.streams[runID], f.streamHandler
	f.mu.Unlock()
	if expired {
		data, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata", "api", "stream-expired.json"))
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusGone)
		_, _ = w.Write(data)
		return
	}
	if handler != nil {
		handler(w, r, runID)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
	_, _ = w.Write(stream)
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, v any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
}

func writeAPIError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code, message string) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code, "message": message}})
}

// useSettings isolates the provider's package settings and key for one test.
func useSettings(t *testing.T, envKey string) {
	t.Helper()
	t.Setenv(apiKeyEnvVar, envKey)
	prevKey, prevMirror, prevOverride := configAPIKey, configMirrorDir, userDataDirOverride
	configAPIKey, configMirrorDir, userDataDirOverride = "", "", ""
	t.Cleanup(func() { configAPIKey, configMirrorDir, userDataDirOverride = prevKey, prevMirror, prevOverride })
}

// fakeClock drives a rateLimiter deterministically: sleeping advances time.
type fakeClock struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	now   time.Time
	slept []time.Duration
}

func (c *fakeClock) Now() time.Time {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return c.now
}

func (c *fakeClock) Sleep(_ context.Context, d time.Duration) error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.slept = append(c.slept, d)
	c.now = c.now.Add(d)
	return nil
}

func TestRateLimiterSpacesRequests(t *testing.T) {
	clock := &fakeClock{now: time.Unix(1_800_000_000, 0)}
	limiter := &rateLimiter{interval: 3 * time.Second, now: clock.Now, sleep: clock.Sleep}

	for range 3 {
		if err := limiter.wait(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	// The first request goes at once; each later one waits out the interval.
	want := []time.Duration{3 * time.Second, 3 * time.Second}
	if len(clock.slept) != len(want) || clock.slept[0] != want[0] || clock.slept[1] != want[1] {
		t.Errorf("slept %v, want %v", clock.slept, want)
	}

	// A 429 seen by one caller pushes every later slot past its Retry-After.
	limiter.holdUntil(clock.Now().Add(20 * time.Second))
	clock.slept = nil
	if err := limiter.wait(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(clock.slept) != 1 || clock.slept[0] != 20*time.Second {
		t.Errorf("after holdUntil slept %v, want [20s]", clock.slept)
	}
}

func TestClientRetriesThrottledRequests(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name       string
		status     int
		retryAfter string
		wantDelay  time.Duration
	}{
		{"429 with Retry-After seconds", http.StatusTooManyRequests, "7", 7 * time.Second},
		{"429 without Retry-After backs off", http.StatusTooManyRequests, "", initialBackoff},
		{"503 retried", http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "", initialBackoff},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			calls := 0
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				calls++
				if calls == 1 {
					if tt.retryAfter != "" {
						w.Header().Set("Retry-After", tt.retryAfter)
					}
					writeAPIError(w, tt.status, "rate_limited", "slow down")
					return
				}
				_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"apiKeyName":"k"}`))
			}))
			defer server.Close()

			clock := &fakeClock{now: time.Unix(1_800_000_000, 0)}
			c := newAPIClient("test-key")
			c.baseURL = server.URL
			c.limiter = &rateLimiter{interval: 0, now: clock.Now, sleep: clock.Sleep}

			me, err := c.me(context.Background())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("me: %v", err)
			}
			if me.APIKeyName != "k" || calls != 2 {
				t.Errorf("got key %q after %d calls, want k after 2", me.APIKeyName, calls)
			}
			if len(clock.slept) != 1 || clock.slept[0] != tt.wantDelay {
				t.Errorf("slept %v, want [%v]", clock.slept, tt.wantDelay)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestClientGivesUpAfterMaxRetries(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		calls++
		writeAPIError(w, http.StatusTooManyRequests, "rate_limited", "slow down")
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	clock := &fakeClock{now: time.Unix(1_800_000_000, 0)}
	c := newAPIClient("test-key")
	c.baseURL = server.URL
	c.limiter = &rateLimiter{interval: 0, now: clock.Now, sleep: clock.Sleep}

	_, err := c.me(context.Background())
	var ae *apiError
	if !errors.As(err, &ae) || ae.Status != http.StatusTooManyRequests {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v, want a 429 apiError", err)
	}
	if calls != maxRetries+1 {
		t.Errorf("calls = %d, want %d", calls, maxRetries+1)
	}
}

func TestOpenStreamExpired(t *testing.T) {
	f := newFakeAPI(t)
	f.expired["run-1"] = true
	_, err := newAPIClient("test-key").openStream(context.Background(), "bc-1", "run-1", "")
	if !errors.Is(err, errStreamExpired) {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v, want errStreamExpired", err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "Run stream is no longer available") {
		t.Errorf("err = %v, want the API's message from the captured 410 body", err)
	}
}

func TestOpenStreamIdleTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	prev := streamIdleTimeout
	streamIdleTimeout = 50 * time.Millisecond
	t.Cleanup(func() { streamIdleTimeout = prev })

	f := newFakeAPI(t)
	release := make(chan struct{})
	defer close(release)
	f.streamHandler = func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, runID string) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("event: heartbeat\ndata: {}\n\n"))
		w.(http.Flusher).Flush()
		// Then silence: a dead connection the client must notice by itself.
		select {
		case <-release:
		case <-r.Context().Done():
		}
	}
	body, err := newAPIClient("test-key").openStream(context.Background(), "bc-1", "run-1", "")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = body.Close() }()

	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		done <- readSSE(body, "test", func(sseEvent) bool { return true })
	}()
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		if err == nil {
			t.Error("readSSE returned nil, want the idle cancellation error")
		}
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("stream read did not time out")
	}
}
```
